subject: ela
intro: Analyze and evaluate the effectiveness of structure.

items.prompt:
How an author arranges the parts of a text is its:
A) structure
B) font
C) length

Judging how WELL a structure works is to:
A) evaluate it
B) ignore it
C) rename it

An effective structure makes an argument's points:
A) clear and convincing
B) hidden
C) confusing

An author opens with a gripping anecdote, then data, then answers objections. This structure is EFFECTIVE because it:
A) engages, convinces, and anticipates doubts
B) hides the point
C) bores the reader
items.answer: A) engages, convinces, and anticipates doubts

steps: All three goals met. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) engages, convinces, and anticipates doubts

items.prompt:
An argument buries its main claim in the last line after pages of unrelated detail. This structure is:
A) ineffective, because the point is unclear until too late
B) highly effective
C) perfectly clear
items.answer: A) ineffective, because the point is unclear until too late

solution.answer: A) ineffective, because the point is unclear until too late

items.prompt:
To EVALUATE a structure means to:
A) judge how well it makes points clear, convincing, and engaging
B) only name it
C) count its paragraphs
items.answer: A) judge how well it makes points clear, convincing, and engaging

solution.answer: A) judge how well it makes points clear, convincing, and engaging

items.prompt:
Two essays argue the same point. One states its thesis up front and builds support; the other withholds its thesis and wanders. The FIRST is more effective because its structure:
A) orients the reader and builds a clear, convincing case
B) hides the argument longer
C) adds more words
items.answer: A) orients the reader and builds a clear, convincing case

steps: Clear structure = effective. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) orients the reader and builds a clear, convincing case

items.prompt:
Evaluating the effectiveness of a text's structure means asking whether it:
A) makes the points clear, convincing, and engaging
B) uses the most words
C) has the oldest sources
items.answer: A) makes the points clear, convincing, and engaging

solution.answer: A) makes the points clear, convincing, and engaging
